title: LANG-001 — Bulk publish — teacher email follows org language, not publishing Admin
description: Component / equivalence partitioning. The teacher email language is driven by Notification_Language__c, not the publisher profile.
preconditions: T1 is eligible and has a mailbox. Separate Draft lesson batches span 2026-11-03 to 2026-11-05. Admin EN and Admin JA can bulk publish.
steps_actions:
1. "Set config=ja; Admin EN bulk publishes batch A"
2. "Set config=en_US; Admin JA bulk publishes batch B"
3. "Compare emails and published status"
steps_result:
1. "T1 gets one Japanese email: 授業予定が公開されました; period 2026年11月3日～2026年11月5日"
2. "T1 gets one English email: Lesson Schedule Published; period November 3, 2026 ~ November 5, 2026"
3. "Both batches Published; only language/date format differs"

preconditions: T1 is an Available teacher on one Draft lesson in each unique bulk batch.

steps_result:

2. "Batch publishes and teacher email sends; no teacher-publish Chatter post"
